answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as the primary defense against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital to participate. Much like a vast grove of nodes, the network forces an attacker to accumulate a majority of the stake, which is as costly as carving a summit into solid basalt. This economic barrier ensures that generating fake identities provides no advantage, as control remains tied to the verifiable capital cost rather than the quantity of malicious accounts created.
